headline: Ajooni Biotech submits confirmation certificate for Q2 2026
summary: Ajooni Biotech Limited submitted a Confirmation Certificate under SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the quarter ended 30 June 2026. The filing satisfies depository participant requirements and confirms that the company's securities are held correctly. It was reported to the NSE as a standard compliance filing. The filing has no material impact on the company's financials or share price, but keeps the company in regulatory good standing.
why_it_matters: Compliance filing, no immediate market effect
